description: This file defines the SearchFilesTool class, which extends BaseTool to implement a file search utility using regex. It includes methods for executing searches, handling partial inputs, and parsing legacy parameters.

classes.name: SearchFilesTool
classes.description: A class extending BaseTool to perform regex-based file searches with support for partial handling and legacy parsing.

methods.name: parseLegacy
methods.description: Parses legacy parameters into SearchFilesParams object.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the file search operation, handles user approval, and manages errors.

methods.name: handlePartial
methods.description: Handles partial search requests, constructing and sending partial messages.
